prompt: I want to hang out with people, but at the same time I enjoy my alone time. I feel like I’m a very introverted person. How do I get out there and enjoy life and meet people if I also have a strong desire to stay at home and speak to no one? I don’t want o be alone forever.
response: It's great that you want to explore your interests outside of your comfort zone. If you want to stay at home and speak to no one, you can focus on hobbies and activities that don't require much interaction. This will help you avoid feeling alone and allow you to pursue your passions without the pressure of social engagement.
